definitions.explanation: A portable device used to put out small fires. Required in buildings throughout Japan by fire safety regulations.

examples.japanese: {消火器|しょうかき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{消火器|しょうかき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}っています→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Do you know how to use a fire extinguisher?

examples.japanese: ⟦{廊下|ろうか}→廊下：05005_rouka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}いてある→置く：01092_oku⟧{消火器|しょうかき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{期限|きげん}→期限：12861_kigen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check the expiration date on the fire extinguisher in the hallway.

notes:
USAGE:
An everyday word found in safety contexts. Fire extinguishers are required in buildings in Japan and are commonly seen in hallways, kitchens, and near exits.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {消火器|しょうかき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use a fire extinguisher)
- {消火器|しょうかき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧ (installation of fire extinguishers)
- {消火器|しょうかき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧ (fire extinguisher inspection)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{消火器|しょうかき} (fire extinguisher, a device) vs. ⟦{消化器|しょうかき}→消化器：06012_shoukaki⟧ (digestive organs). The kanji differ: {火|か} (fire) vs. ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (transform).
